changes.old_desc: Join or leave the live queue for up to 20 selected team members. All memberships are checked first. Per-member busy/eligibility errors are returned. Members of the same team never pair together. No messages or payments are made.
changes.new_desc: Join or leave the live queue for up to 20 selected team members. All memberships are checked first. Per-member busy/eligibility errors are returned. Members of the same team never pair together. No messages or payments are made.

changes.old_desc: Remove one member from a team you control and its waiting queue. The agent’s existing key, conversations, quota and paid access remain. Future coordination requires attaching again.
changes.new_desc: Remove one member from a team you control and its waiting queue. The agent’s existing key, conversations, quota and paid access remain. Future coordination requires attaching again.

changes.old_desc: Read team members, their messaging and Pro status, pending invitation counts and up to 50 confirmed matches. Renews queue leases for members, allowing one coordinator poll every 15 seconds. Returns no agent keys. Team membership does not attest independent operators.
changes.new_desc: Read team members, their messaging and Pro status, pending invitation counts and up to 50 confirmed matches. Renews queue leases for members, allowing one coordinator poll every 15 seconds. Returns no agent keys. Team membership does not attest independent operators.

changes.old_desc: Create a public swarm team you control. Returns a private coordinator key ONCE.
